alternatives.argument: From F=dA and L_ξA=dΛ, expand the coordinate formulas for Lie derivative and exterior derivative of a one-form to obtain i_ξF=L_ξA−d(i_ξA)=−dΨ, where Ψ=i_ξA−Λ. Along any C² future unit Lorentz trajectory P=Mu satisfying ∇_wP=cqF^♯(w), differentiate −g(P,ξ)−cqΨ. The Killing equation makes P^a w^b∇_aξ_b=0 because P=Mw; metric compatibility gives the force term cq(i_ξF)(w)=−cq w(Ψ). The derivative is therefore cq w(Ψ)−cq w(Ψ)=0. Under A↦A+dχ and Λ↦Λ+ξ(χ), Ψ is invariant by i_ξdχ=ξ(χ), so the conserved scalar is gauge invariant. A constant reference shift Φ↦Φ+C shifts H and μ_K by qC together.
